proof.text: Identify the retained exteriorSheafPresheaf with the upstream exterior-power presheaf by identity isomorphisms on section modules: uniqueness of exterior restrictions proves naturality. Sheafify this isomorphism. Naturality of the sheafification unit shows that its hom and inv preserve wedge sections. Conjugate the upstream exteriorSheaf_map_exists morphism for S.g by these isomorphisms to obtain the map e on the retained exteriorSheaf objects. Form q as identity tensor e. The tensor-section naturality lemma and the transferred pure-wedge formula prove the formula for q.

Obtain the pre-quotient wedge map psi from exteriorSheaf_wedgeMap_exists, applied to S.f. The upstream theorem uses native exterior powers. Identify each legacy exterior presheaf with its native counterpart by identity maps on objects; restriction compatibility follows from the unique pure-wedge restriction formula. Sheafify these isomorphisms, use naturality of the unit to check their hom and inverse on pure wedges, and conjugate the upstream wedge map by the tensor of the two source comparisons and the inverse target comparison. tensorHom_app_tmulSection gives exactly the legacy wedge formula.

Conjugate q by the tensor of canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso maps, and conjugate the pre-quotient wedge by the source tensor inverse and target comparison. tensorHom_app_tmulSection and the inverse and forward comparison formulas verify the official pure-wedge hypotheses. Apply the proved official determinant_wedge_quotient_factor. Transport the resulting factorization back with the target comparison inverse; exteriorSheafTensor_lift_hom_ext checks its equation on pure-wedge generators. This fully proved private bridge preserves the consumer signature and factorization argument.

Evaluate q followed by phi equals psi on the tensor of the wedge of a and the wedge of c. Substitute the pure-wedge formulas for q and psi, and replace the tuple S.g(c) by b using the given lift equations. This yields the required value of phi on U.

lean.statement: theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_local_data_at {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] (U : X.Opens) : ∃ φU : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂, ∀ (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) → φU.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
